data.name: ACR Carbon (ACR)
data.description: ACR (formerly American Carbon Registry) is a nonprofit carbon crediting program and registry, founded in 1996 as the world's first private voluntary GHG registry and operated as a subsidiary of Winrock International. It issues standards and methodologies, and runs a registry for voluntary and compliance carbon markets (including California, Washington State, CORSIA). ACR does not itself remove CO2 — it is part of the ecosystem issuing and tracking carbon credits, including CDR credits.
